list_pages.code:
response = client.pages.list_pages({"search": "about", "visibility": "open", "sort": "name", "order": "asc"})
for page in response.map["pages"]:
    print(page["id"], page["name"], page["url"], page["visibility"])
print(response.map["pagination"]["has_next"])

create_page.code:
response = client.pages.create_page({"page": {
    "name": "About us",

    "visibility": "open",

}})
